endpoints.sharing: primary: paired family mean of B2 final J minus B3 final J
endpoints.worker: primary: paired family fixed-corpus geometry-plus-wire success rate, adapter minus base
endpoints.thermal_objective: versioned active-chip-layer grid peak; maximum over all frozen scenarios; lower is better

families.fallback_approval: before any outcome, from frozen stratified order
families.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean within family before testing
families.incomplete_required_pair: apply the frozen final-evidence/loss policy; never drop a family or seed, average over only observed seeds, or treat missingness as a measured tie
families.worker_ties: exact equality of rational success rates
families.ties: exclude endpoint-specific ties from that endpoint denominator and report n
families.test: two-sided exact family sign test; beneficial-direction confirmatory p vector frozen before Holm
families.multiplicity: Holm across both sharing and worker using the confirmatory p vector, never raw p values followed by a direction check
families.six_non_tied_rule: 6/6 may pass second at .05 only after the other primary passes first at .025; a six-family design stays descriptive

missing_family_adverse_sign.scope: only a pre-named treatment beneficial-direction primary claim under pins.missing_family_primary_claims; not a harm claim or a secondary endpoint
missing_family_adverse_sign.retention: retain all frozen families and both seed positions; endpoint-specific measured ties alone reduce n; never remove unfavorable or missing families
missing_family_adverse_sign.analysis: apply adverse family signs for missing required evidence only as preregistered; form confirmatory_p_vector BEFORE two-primary Holm, using raw two-sided p only for wins > losses and otherwise 1 for each named primary; never check direction only after Holm
missing_family_adverse_sign.report: report measured wins, losses and ties separately from imputed adverse signs and missing seed/family evidence
missing_family_adverse_sign.prohibitions: never invent temperatures, fabricate seed means, convert missingness to a measured failure, or infer harm from imputed losses

families.no_loss_probability_caveat: quoted 2.1452% and 68.1118% assume iid homogeneous failures; not measured reliability

confirmatory_p_vector.favorable_direction: wins > losses after preregistered adverse-sign imputation; measured endpoint-specific ties excluded
confirmatory_p_vector.apply: before Holm sorting and threshold comparisons
confirmatory_p_vector.report: retain raw two-sided p values descriptively alongside confirmatory p values; measured wins/losses/ties and imputed adverse signs reported separately

B2.system: four isolated labs with base worker

B3.system: four shared-evidence labs with base worker

B4.system: four shared-evidence labs with adapted worker

budget.unit: all-scenario bundle per family x seed x arm
budget.transfer: forbidden between labs, phases, arms, seeds or families
budget.initialization: initial reference and refinement charges must be pinned before execution; no free search opportunity
budget.cache_and_shared_sample: every requesting lab spends its opportunity using the authoritative measurement; no cross-arm reuse
budget.invalid_or_failed_search: spends search slot; no free substitute
budget.duplicate_nomination: each lab spends and records its own reproduction slot
budget.retry: exactly one declared transient infrastructure retry only after proven pre-execution failure; same candidate/context/slot; record all attempts and costs; no substitute
budget.retry_accounting: free only on proof solve never started; uncertain or post-start launch consumes slot; at most one pre-execution retry, never another charged attempt in same slot
budget.cross_architecture: same reproduction slot only if frozen reproducer policy authorizes it; no free extra evidence
budget.lost_opportunity: a consumed search or reproduction loss remains charged and never earns a replacement; preserve reason and execution evidence even if an otherwise valid final board survives

held_out_no_result_retries.scope: fixed held-out corpus evaluation; not additional chiplet search/reproduction opportunities
held_out_no_result_retries.prerequisites: freeze attempt schedule, seed schedule, idempotency and ordering, symmetric retry limits and every charge before outcomes
held_out_no_result_retries.selection: first complete measurement-valid evaluation in frozen attempt order before any success, nomination margin or favorable-direction test; never retry measured scientific failure for a better result
held_out_no_result_retries.accounting: retain every attempt and charge including no-result attempts; fixed inputs alone do not remove selection bias; chiplet remains at 32 with its existing pre-execution-only retry rule

epoch.reference: immutable initial reference, shared by all labs for the entire search
epoch.barrier: every lab search closed before any reproduction in each of B0 through B4; all slots terminal before final gate
epoch.sharing: B3 and B4 may share evaluated evidence during search; no reproduction or accepted-board updates during search
epoch.demo: sequential live-loop board is demonstration only, never benchmark evidence
epoch.scope: family x seed x arm; immutable context binds evaluator, metric, scenarios and physical-layout canonicalization
epoch.missing: cancelled/no-result and unobserved infrastructure losses remain distinct from measured scientific failures; no free replacement; a consumed loss need not invalidate an otherwise valid final board; apply frozen final-evidence/loss and claim-specific missing-family policies
epoch.final_board_policy: freeze board fallback, required final evidence, loss counting/limits, and treatment of missing reference, scorer, seed and global STOP before outcomes; unresolved pins block execution

nomination.ranking: exact finite evaluated J ascending, then canonical physical-layout hash ascending; no tolerance in comparator
nomination.same_hash: one authoritative measurement per physical-layout/context; retain separate proposal/lab/slot identities and charges
nomination.eligibility: filter valid candidates first: positive reference J minus evaluated J >= acceptance_margin + reference uncertainty + candidate uncertainty
nomination.measurement_selection: select first complete measurement-valid evaluation in frozen attempt order BEFORE testing nomination margin; never first favorable or qualifying result; a margin failure cannot advance to a later repeat
nomination.normalization_evidence: preserve each slot original independent reproduction and per-slot agreement evidence, B2 isolation, attempt provenance and charge BEFORE duplicate normalization; one authoritative measurement never replaces a slot evidence obligation

gate.ranking: exact finite reproduced J ascending, then canonical physical-layout hash; accept the first qualified reproduction
gate.accepted: one winner with positive improvement reaching the frozen-reference margin plus both uncertainties; becomes the board
gate.within_margin: 0 < board J minus candidate J < acceptance_margin + board uncertainty + candidate uncertainty; exact boundary qualifies
gate.reproduction: fresh independent worker/process, identical bound inputs and frozen context; absolute J discrepancy <= reproduction_tolerance
gate.margin_binding: rank_order_gate rejects null acceptance_margin or a caller margin unequal to the frozen value
